Class AbstractFileRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object
repository.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
repository.AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - type of the entity id
E - type of the entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
FriendshipFileRepository, UserFileRepository
public abstract class AbstractFileRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>> extends InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
In-memory repository whose content is persisted in a text file, one entity per line.

Template Method: this class implements loading and saving; subclasses only define how a line is converted to an entity (extractEntity(String)) and back (createEntityAsString(Entity)).

A corrupt or invalid line is reported on the error stream (file, line number and reason) and ignored; the file is rewritten without it at the next successful change.

  • Constructor Details

    • AbstractFileRepository

      protected AbstractFileRepository(Validator<E> validator, String fileName)
      Creates the repository and loads the data from the file, if it exists. A missing file is not an error: the repository starts empty and the file is created at the first save.
      Parameters:
      validator - the validation strategy
      fileName - relative path of the file
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the file exists but cannot be read

  • Method Details

    • extractEntity

      protected abstract E extractEntity(String line)
      Converts a line of the file to an entity.

      It is called while the constructor of this class is running, before the fields of the subclass are initialized, so implementations must not use fields of the subclass.

      Parameters:
      line - a non-blank line
      Returns:
      the entity
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the line is malformed
